description: Create vendors table with RLS, soft-delete column, and category FK.
steps: Apply migration locally; assert vendors table exists with id/name/category_id/deleted_at columns.
Assert RLS enabled and 'vendors_select_active' policy exists.
Insert one test row; assert SELECT as anon returns it; UPDATE as anon rejected.

description: POST /vendors creates vendor row and triggers WhatsApp send.
steps: POST sample payload to /submit-vendor edge function; assert 200 + row inserted.
Assert whatsapp_send_log has one queued entry for this vendor.
Assert types.ts regenerated with Vendor row type.

description: Vendor add form at 375px — name, phone, category fields visible, ONE submit CTA.
steps: Visual assert: ONE primary submit CTA visible (no duplicate header button).
Visual assert: name/phone/category fields stack vertically.
Submit valid form; screenshot success state; assert success copy matches spec.
verification_mode_rationale: Every acceptance criterion (single CTA, vertical stack of fields, success copy match) is expressible via querySelectorAll counts, getComputedStyle, and textContent. No visual quality judgment needed — screenshots go to disk for owner review only.

description: Vendor add success card at 375px — composition matches direction-B warm mood, illustration optically aligns with confirmation copy.
steps: Playwright navigate to /add-vendor at 375px and submit a valid payload.
Wait for success state; screenshot full viewport.
Agent Reads the screenshot and confirms: success-card illustration optically centers above the confirmation copy (not just geometrically — visual judgment).
Agent Reads the screenshot and confirms: warm-Mediterranean palette is in evidence (no out-of-token color leaks).
DOM assert: ONE success heading visible (no duplicate header).
DOM assert: confirmation textContent matches spec copy verbatim.
verification_mode_rationale: Two criteria require visual judgment: (1) optical (not geometric) alignment of illustration over copy, (2) palette feel matching direction-B mood. Neither is fully captured by getComputedStyle or getBoundingClientRect. The other criteria stay DOM-asserted, but the presence of even one genuinely-visual criterion makes the whole task visual-review.
